invariants.expression: alignment == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.left || alignment == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.center || alignment == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.right
invariants.rationale: The documentation states that alignment must be 'left', 'center', or 'right', referencing the Align class constants.
Commonly, alignment constants are positive integers. This invariant checks that the alignment is non-negative.
It's unlikely for alignment to be set to Integer.MIN_VALUE, as alignment options are usually meaningful small integers.
